articles.title: Gold Prices Plunge 9% In Worst Weekly Drop In 8 Months Amid Hawkish Fed And High Yields
articles.description: Spot gold tumbled over 9% this week amid aggressive rate-hike fears. Surging crude oil prices from the war in West Asia have pushed US 10-year bond yields above 5% and strengthened the US dollar, driving speculative sell-offs. Analysts and fund houses expect a long-term recovery as easing energy prices cool inflation and lower yields next year.

articles.description: An illegal fuel depot where A-95 petrol and diesel fuel were produced for sale through filling stations in Kyiv and other regions has been uncovered in the Ukrainian capital. Assets seized during the operation are valued at about UAH 10 million. — Ukrinform.
